entries.ro: Am cam nevoie de un doctor.

entries.en: Was wonderin' what kind of "vitamins" you might have under the counter.
entries.ro: Mă întrebam ce fel de „vitamine” ai sub tejghea.

entries.en: I take it you're not in the market for vitamin C... Yeah, I think we're well stocked on what you're shoppin' for.
entries.ro: Bănuiesc că nu ești pe vitamina C... Da, avem destul din ce-ți trebuie.

entries.en: But if anybody in blue asks, you weren't here.
entries.ro: Dar dacă întreabă vreun polițist, tu n-ai fost aici.
